title: Tokens never leak
description: With canary refresh and ID tokens, the built binary over real stdio and the in-memory server are driven through successful calls, Firestore 401/403/500, securetoken 400 and timeouts.
criterion: With canary refresh and ID tokens, the built binary over real stdio and the in-memory server are driven through successful calls, Firestore 401/403/500, securetoken 400 and timeouts; the canaries never occur in stdout frames, stderr, tool results or errors, and stdout contains only JSON-RPC frames.
prerequisites: Go 1.27+, Node 20+ (for the web-side checks). No network, no real account: a local fake Firebase is used.
